overall: AG found the committee violated the OML by creating insufficient executive session minutes for January 14, 2025, and ordered revised minutes; the untimely records-response allegation was declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to respond within ten days to a records request for executive session minutes made in March 2025.
allegations.key_passage: Since the complaint was not filed until January 8, 2026, 291 days later, we find this allegation in the complaint to be untimely and decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the executive session minutes of the January 14, 2025 meeting were insufficiently detailed, both as originally written and as amended.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create sufficiently accurate and detailed minutes.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of the letter, revise the January 14, 2025 executive session minutes to include a summary of the complainant’s statement, and notify the AG's office that it has done so.
remedy_passage: In addition, we order the Committee, within 30 days of the date of this letter, to revise the minutes of the January 14, 2025, executive session to include a summary of the complainant’s statement, and to notify our office that it has done so.
